build: dancer's frame — narrow shoulders, defined collarbone, minimal softness
hair: black, thick and slightly wavy, worn long past her shoulders with a natural shine; she braids it when stressed
complexion: warm golden-olive undertone; a small beauty mark just above her left jawline
face: heart-shaped with high, prominent cheekbones and a pointed chin — a face that reads as watchful first, then luminous when she smiles; dark eyes set wide apart with a slight downward tilt at the outer corners
signature_feature: her hands — long-fingered, expressive, constantly moving; the LI notices how she holds things, how she gestures mid-sentence, the precise way her fingers curl when she's thinking
second_celebrated_feature: the small scar on her left temple (a childhood accident) that catches light and makes her look less polished, more real
signature_habits: she hums while working — usually classical Persian music her grandmother taught her; she touches her collarbone when nervous or overwhelmed; she drinks black tea from the same chipped ceramic cup every morning; she speaks in rapid, overlapping thoughts when excited, mixing in Farsi words without noticing ('Khob, so I was thinking...')
occupation: textile designer and owner of a small independent studio in the city — she creates custom fabrics and bespoke commissions for high-end interior designers and boutique clients

current_crisis.event: her studio's main supplier — a family-run mill she's trusted for three years — just went bankrupt overnight; she has two major client deadlines in four weeks and no way to source the specialty fabrics she promised
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic threaded with shame — she feels she's failed the clients who trusted her, failed her small team
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a new supplier fast enough to save the commissions, or to confess to her clients before they find out from someone else

wound.core: she believes that if she's not indispensable — if she can't solve every problem alone — she becomes disposable
wound.surfacing_hint: when overwhelmed, she stops asking for help and spirals into solving-mode, working until 3 a.m., convinced that admitting difficulty means admitting failure; she flinches when someone offers assistance without being asked
